arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ الْمُتأبِّدِ بِالْخُلُودِ وَالْسُلْطَانِ الْمُمْتَنِعِ بِغَيْرِ جُنُود وَلاَ أَعْوَان، وَالْعِزِّ الْبَاقِي عَلَى مَرِّ الدُّهُورِ، وَخَوَالِي الأَعْوَامِ، وَمَوَاضِي الأَزْمَانِ وَالأيَّامِ،
transliteration: allāhumma yā dhā al-mulki al-mutābbid bi-l-khulūdi wa-s-sulṭāni al-mumtaniiʿ bi-ghayri junuudin wa laa aʿwaan wal-ʿizzil-bāqi ʿalā marrid-duhūr wa-khawālī al-aʿwām, wa-mawāḍī al-azmān wa-l-ayyām
english_text: O God, O Possessor of kingdom perpetual in everlastingness, authority invincible without armies or helpers, might abiding through aeons past, years gone by, times and days elapsed!

arabic_text: عَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ عِزّاً لا حَدَّ لَهُ بِأَوَّلِيَّةٍ وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى لَهُ بِآخِرِيَّةٍ،
transliteration: ʿazzat sultānuka ʿizzan lā ḥadda lahū bi-awwaliyyatin walā muntaḥā lahū bi-ākhirīyyah
english_text: Thy authority is mighty with a might that knows no bound by being first nor utmost end by being last!

arabic_text: وَاسْتَعْلَى مُلْكُكَ عُلُوّاً سَقَطَتِ الأشْيَاءُ دُونَ بُلُوغِ أَمَدِهِ
transliteration: wa-istaʿlā mulkuka ʿulūwwan saqatatil-ashyāʾu dūna bulūghi amadihi
english_text: Thy kingdom towers high with a towering before which all things fall down without reaching its term;

arabic_text: وَلاَ يَبْلُغُ أَدْنَى مَا اسْتَأثَرْتَ بِـهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَقْصَى نَعْتِ النَّـاعِتِينَ.
transliteration: walā yablughu adnā mā istaʾthartabihi min dhālika aqṣā naʿti al-naʿitīn
english_text: the least of it which Thou hast kept to Thyself is not reached by the furthest description of the describers!

arabic_text: ضَلَّتْ فِيْـكَ الصِّفَاتُ وَتَفَسْخَتْ دُونَكَ النُّعُوتُ وَحَارَتْ فِي كِبْرِيِائِكَ لَطَائِفُ الأوْهَامِ،
transliteration: ḍallaت fīka aṣ-ṣifātu wa tafasxat dūnaka an-nuʿūtu waḥārat fī kibrīyā’ika laṭā’ifu al-awhām
english_text: Attributes go astray in Thee, descriptions fall apart below Thee, the subtlest of imaginations are bewildered by Thy magnificence!

arabic_text: كَذلِكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الأَوَّلُ فِي أَوَّلِيَّتِكَ، وَعَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنْتَ دَائِمٌ لا تَزُولُ،
transliteration: kaḏalika anta allāhu al-ʾawwalu fī ʾawwaliyyatika wa ʿalā dhālika anta dāʾimun lā tazūlu
english_text: So art Thou: God, the First in Thy firstness, and so art Thou everlastingly. Thou dost not pass away.

arabic_text: وَأَنَا الْعَبْدُ الضَّعِيْفُ عَمَلاً الجَسِيْمُ أَمَلاً،
transliteration: wa ana al-'abdu al-ḍaʿīfu ʿamalan al-jasīmu amalan
english_text: But I am the slave, feeble in works, immense in hopes.

arabic_text: خَرَجَتْ مِنْ يَدِي أَسْبَابُ الْوُصُلاَت إلاّ مَا وَصَلَهُ رَحْمَتُكَ ،
transliteration: kharajat min yadi asbabul wusulati illa ma wasalahu rahmatuk
english_text: The tying links are outside my hand, except what is tied by Thy mercy;

arabic_text: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ عَنِّي عِصَمُ الآمَالِ إلاّ مَا أَنَا مُعْتَصِمٌ بِهِ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ،
transliteration: wa taqaṭṭaʿat ʿannī ʿiṣamu al-āmāl illā mā anā muʿtassimun bihī min ʿafwik
english_text: the bonds of hopes have been cut away from me, except the pardon to which I hold fast.

arabic_text: قَلَّ عِنْدِي مَا أَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَكَثُرَ عَلَيَّ مَا أَبُوءُ بِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
transliteration: qalla ʿindi mā ʾaʿtaddu bihi min ṭāʿatika wa kathura ʿalayya mā ʾabū'u bihī min maʿṣiyatika
english_text: Little on my part is the obedience toward Thee upon which I count, and great against me the disobedience toward Thee to which I have reverted.

arabic_text: وَلَنْ يَضِيْقَ عَلَيْكَ عَفْوٌ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ وَإنْ أَسَاءَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
transliteration: walay yaḍīqa ʿalayka ʿafwun ʿan ʿabdik, wa-in asāʾa faʿfu ʿannī
english_text: But pardoning Thy slave will not constrain Thee, even if he be bad, so pardon me!

arabic_text: أللَّهًمَّ وَقَدْ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى خَفَايَا الأَعْمَالِ عِلْمُكَ وَانْكَشَفَ كُلُّ مَسْتُور دُونَ خُبْرِكَ وَلاَ تَنْطَوِي عَنْكَ دَقَائِقُ الأُمُورِ وَلاَ تَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ غَيِّبَاتُ السَّرَائِرِ،
transliteration: allāhumma waqad ashrafa ʿalā khafāyā al-aʿmāli ʿilmuka wa-ankashafa kullu mastoorin doona khubrika walā tanṭawī ʿanka daqāʾiq al-umūr walā taʿzubu ʿanka ghayyibātu al-sarāʾir
english_text: O God, Thy knowledge watches over hidden works every covered thing is exposed before Thy awareness, the intricacies of things are not concealed from Thee, and unseen mysteries slip not away from Thee.

arabic_text: وَقَدِ اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيَّ عَدُوُّكَ الَّذِي اسْتَنْظَرَكَ لِغِوَايتِي فَأَنْظَرْتَهُ،
transliteration: wa qad istaḥwaḏa ʿalayya ʿaduwwuka alladhi istanẓaraka li-ghiwayti fa-anẓarhtahu
english_text: But over me Thy enemy has gained mastery: He asked a delay from Thee to lead me astray, and Thou gavest him the delay!

arabic_text: وَاسْتَمْهَلَكَ إلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ لاِضْلاَلِي فَأَمْهَلْتَهُ،
transliteration: wa astamhala-ka ila yawm al-deen, la-id-dal-li fa-am-hal-tahu
english_text: He asked a respite from Thee until the Day of Doom to misguide me, and Thou gavest him the respite!

arabic_text: فَأوْقَعَنِيْ وَقَدْ هَرَبْتُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ صَغَائِرِ ذُنُوبٍ مُوبِقَةٍ وَكَبَائِرِ أَعْمَالٍ مُرْدِيَـةٍ حَتَّى إذَا قَارَفْتُ مَعْصِيَتَـكَ
transliteration: fa-aqʿaani waqad harabtu ilayka min sagha'ir dhunubin mubiqah wa kabāʾiri aʿmālin murdiyat ḥattā ʾiḏā qārafatu maʿṣiyataka
english_text: So he threw me down, though I had fled to Thee from small, ruinous sins and great, deadly works, until, when I had yielded to disobeying Thee

arabic_text: وَاسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِسُوءِ سَعْيِي سَخْطَتَكَ فَتَلَ عَنِّي عِذَارَ غَدْرِهِ، وَتَلَقَّانِي بكَلِمَةِ كُفْرهِ، وَتَوَلَّى الْبَراءَةَ مِنِّي وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيَاً عَنِّي،
transliteration: wa astawjabtu bi su'i saʿyi sakhṭatuka fa talā ʿannī ʿiḏāra ghadrihi wa talqānī bi kalimati kufrh wa tawallā al-barā'ata minnī wa adbarra muwaliyāan 'anni
english_text: and merited Thy anger through my bad efforts, he turned the bridle of his treachery away from me, met me with the word of his ingratitude, undertook to be quit of me, turned his back to flee from me,

arabic_text: فَأَصْحَرنِي لِغَضَبِكَ فَرِيداً، وَأَخْرَجَني إلى فِنَاءِ نَقِمَتِكَ طَرِيداً
transliteration: fa-ʾaṣḥarnī li-ghaḍabika farīdan wa-akhrajani ila fina'i naqimatika tariidan
english_text: threw me to the desert of Thy wrath alone, and sent me as an outcast into the courtyard of Thy vengeance.

arabic_text: لاَ شَفِيعٌ يَشْفَعُ لِيْ إلَيْـكَ، وَلاَ خَفِيـرٌ يُؤْمِنُنِي عَلَيْـكَ وَلاَ حِصْنٌ يَحْجُبُنِي عَنْكَ وَلاَ مَلاَذٌ أَلْجَأُ إلَيْهِ مِنْكَ.
transliteration: lā shafīʿun yašfaʿu lī ilayk wa lā khafīrun yu'minunī 'alayka walā ḥiṣn yaḥjubunī ʿanka walā malāẓun alja'u ilayhi minka
english_text: There is no intercessor to intercede for me with Thee, no protector to make me feel secure against Thee, no fortress to veil me from Thee, no shelter in which to seek asylum apart from Thee!

arabic_text: فَهَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ، وَمَحَلُّ الْمُعْتَرِفِ لَكَ، فَلاَ يَضِيقَنَّ عَنِّي فَضْلُكَ، وَلا يَقْصُـرَنَّ دونِي عَفْوُكَ،
transliteration: fa-ha-tha maqaamu al-ʿaa'iẓi bika, wa-ma-hal-lu al-muʿta-ri fi-laka fala yaḍīqann ʿannī faḍluka, wa lā yaqṣuran dūnī ʿafwuka
english_text: This is the station of him who takes refuge with Thee, the place of the confessor to Thee: Let not Thy bounty be too narrow for me, let not Thy pardon fall short of me!

arabic_text: وَلا أكُنْ أَخْيَبَ عِبَادِكَ التَّائِبِينَ، وَلاَ أَقْنَطَ وفُودِكَ الآمِلِينَ
transliteration: wa lā akun akhyaba ʿibādika al-tāʾibīn wala aqnaṭa wafuudika al-amileen
english_text: Let me not be the most disappointed of Thy repentant servants, nor the most despairing of those who come to Thee with expectations!

arabic_text: وَاغْفِرْ لِي إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ.
transliteration: wa-ghfir lī innaka khayru al-ghāfirīn
english_text: Forgive me, surely Thou art the best of the forgivers!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِي فَتَرَكْتُ، وَنَهَيْتَنِي فَرَكِبْتُ،
transliteration: allāhumma innaka amartanī fataraktu, wa nahaytanī farakibtu
english_text: O God, Thou commanded me, and I refrained, Thou prohibited me, and I committed.

arabic_text: وَسَوَّلَ لِيَ الْخَطَأَ خَاطِرُ السُّوءِ فَفَرَّطْتُ،
transliteration: wa sawwala liya al-khata'a khatiru al-su'i fafarattu
english_text: evil thoughts tempted me to offend, and I was negligent.

arabic_text: وَلا أَسْتَشْهِدُ عَلَى صِيَامِي نَهَـاراً، وَلاَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِتَهَجُّدِي لَيْلاً،
transliteration: wa lā astashhidu ʿalā ṣiyāmī nahāran wa lā astajīru bi-tahajjudī lailan
english_text: I cannot call upon daytime to witness my fasting, nor can I seek sanctuary in night because of my vigil;

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُثْنِي عَلَيَّ بِإحْيَائِهَا سُنَّةٌ حَـاشَا فُرُوضِـكَ الَّتِي مَنْ ضَيَّعَها هَلَكَ،
transliteration: wa lā tuṯnī ʿalayya bi-iḥyāʾihā sunnah ḥāshā furūḍika allatī man ḍayyaʿahā halaka
english_text: no Sunna praises me for keeping it alive, only Thy obligations, he who neglects which has perished.

arabic_text: وَلَسْتُ أَتَوَسَّلُ إلَيْكَ بِفَضْلِ نَافِلَة مَعَ كَثِيرِ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ مِنْ وَظَائِفِ فُرُوضِكَ، وَتَعَدَّيْتُ عَنْ مَقَامَاتِ حُدُودِكَ إلَى حُرُمَات انْتَهَكْتُهَا، وَكَبَائِرِ ذُنُوب اجْتَرَحْتُهَا
transliteration: wa lastu atawassalu ilayka bi fadli naafilah maʿa kathīri mā aghfaltu min waẓāʾifi furūḍika wa ta`addaytu `an maqamat hududika 'ilā ḥurumāt intahaktuhā, wa kabā'ir dhunūb ijtarahtuhā
english_text: I cannot seek access to Thee through the excellence of a supererogatory work, given the many duties of Thy obligations of which I have been heedless and the stations of Thy bounds which I have transgressed, thereby violating sacred things and committing great sins,

arabic_text: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لِي مِنْ فَضَائِحِهَا سِتْراً.
transliteration: kānat ʿāfiyatuka lī min faḍāʾiḥihā sitran
english_text: though Thou hast given me safety from their disgraces as a covering.

arabic_text: وَهَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْكَ، وَسَخِطَ عَلَيْهَا، وَرَضِيَ عَنْكَ
transliteration: wa hadha maqamu mani stahyaa linafsihi minka wasakhita ʿalayha, waradiya ʿanka
english_text: This is the station of him who is ashamed of himself before Thee, angry with himself, and satisfied with Thee.

arabic_text: فَتَلَقَّاكَ بِنَفْس خَاشِعَة، وَرَقَبَة خَاضِعَة، وَظَهْر مُثْقَل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا وَاقِفاً بَيْنَ الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
transliteration: fatallaqāka binafs khāshiʿah, waraqabah khāḍiʿah, wadhahr muthqal minal-khataaya waqifan bayna al-raghbati ilayka wal-rahbati minka
english_text: He meets Thee with a humble soul, a neck bent down, a back heavy with offenses, hesitating between longing for Thee and fear of Thee.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ أَوْلَى مَنْ رَجَـاهُ، وَأَحَقُّ مَنْ خَشِيَـهُ وَاتّقـاهُ،
transliteration: wa-anta awwala man rajāh wa-aḥaqquman khashiyaahu wa-ittaqahu
english_text: Thou art the most worthy of those in whom he might hope, the most deserving for him to dread and fear.
